requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Ambiguity between conjunction and disjunction resolved by Business Rule BR-01. Requirement decomposed into two distinct functional requirements based on the supported interpretation: (1) Intruder detection and (2) Unauthorized door opening, both triggered by confirmed window damage.

source_fragments: If a window of the car is damaged and the interior surveillance of the car detects an intruder, the safety system shall raise an alarm.

fields.condition: a window of the car is damaged AND the interior surveillance detects an intruder

structured_requirements.final_statement: If a window of the car is damaged and the interior surveillance detects an intruder, the safety system shall raise an alarm.
structuring_notes: Extracted first independent trigger event (intruder detection) from the resolved disjunction. Condition combines window damage (mandatory precondition) with intruder detection.

source_fragments: If a window of the car is damaged and a door of the car is opened without a car key, the safety system shall raise an alarm.

fields.condition: a window of the car is damaged AND a door of the car is opened without a car key

structured_requirements.final_statement: If a window of the car is damaged and a door of the car is opened without a car key, the safety system shall raise an alarm.
structuring_notes: Extracted second independent trigger event (unauthorized door opening) from the resolved disjunction. Condition combines window damage (mandatory precondition) with unauthorized door opening.
